requirements.title: Baked fallback variant
requirements.description: Ship a static fallback variant (hero/features/pricing/cta/download copy) that the UI renders whenever variant selection or section fetches fail, ensuring visitors always see a safe configuration even if the API is unavailable.

validation.notes: The active provider test proves API errors remain unavailable without product fallback, which is the current fail-closed behavior and does not prove this legacy baked-fallback requirement. Keep failing until the fallback contract is decided and its replacement proof is supplied.

The former Beauvoir-owned service fallback test is being retired during this migration. No current API test proves that missing variants trigger a baked fallback response; current tests instead cover configured publication and fail-closed resolution. Keep this requirement in progress pending owner replacement proof or an explicit OT-P0-031 contract decision.

requirements.title: URL variant selection
requirements.description: If variant_slug in URL, force that variant regardless of localStorage

validation.notes: Frontend variant context fetches variant by slug from URL parameter. Tests verify URL takes priority over localStorage.

requirements.title: localStorage persistence
requirements.description: If no URL slug and localStorage has variant ID, reuse that variant

validation.notes: Frontend VariantContext retrieves and stores variant in localStorage. Tests verify persistence across page reloads.

requirements.title: API weight-based selection
requirements.description: If neither URL nor localStorage, API selects variant by weight and frontend stores it in localStorage

validation.notes: Frontend VariantContext calls /api/v1/variants/select and stores result in localStorage. Tests verify selection and storage.

requirements.title: Variant CRUD operations
requirements.description: Admin can create, update weights, disable/archive, and hard delete variants (with confirmation)

validation.notes: All CRUD API endpoints implemented: GET /variants, POST /variants, PATCH /variants/{slug}, DELETE /variants/{slug}

requirements.title: Archived variant handling
requirements.description: Archived variants remain queryable for analytics but ineligible for random selection

validation.notes: Archive endpoint POST /variants/{slug}/archive implemented. SelectVariant excludes archived status.
